messages:
Samir Kapoor: Hey team, excited to start today! Quick kit hiccup: monitor arrived but the aluminum bracket on the stand is bent and there's a visible scratch across the bezel. Dock powers my laptop but the USB-C audio adapter we use for headsets isn't recognized (shows as 'Unknown USB device'). Also corp wifi cert never popped during setup so VPN fails with 'user certificate missing'. Should I open a ticket or file a returns request?

Renee (IT): Welcome, Samir! Sorry about that. First, please snap a couple photos of the monitor damage (bezel + serial sticker) and attach here. For the USB adapter: try the rear USB-C port on the dock and then a direct laptop USB-C->adapter connection to rule out dock vs adapter. For certs, did you run the onboarding script from https://onboard.redwood.example/onboard? If not, run it and let me know if any prompts appear.

Samir Kapoor: Pics attached (IMG_0001.jpg, IMG_0002.jpg) 8MB total9. Tried adapter direct to laptop and it enumerates fine there (shows as 'Redwood USB Audio' in Sound prefs) but not when plugged into the dock. Ran the onboarding script and got a line: "Warning: no user certificate found" then installer finished. VPN still errors with 'user certificate missing'.

Renee (IT): Good isolation — sounds like dock USB passthrough is at fault for the audio device. I'll open a hardware ticket for a dock replacement and a monitor RMA for the damage. For the cert, open certmgr.msc (Windows) or Keychain Access (macOS) and check for a cert issued to your username under Personal/Certificates. If missing, run the cert installer again; if it's present but VPN refuses, paste the exact VPN log: open %PROGRAMDATA%\Redwood\VPN\logs\last.log and paste the last 10 lines.

Logistics Bot: RMA request RM-5589 created for serial MON-8392 (Samir Kapoor). Carrier pickup scheduled for next business day. Replacement monitor will ship once RMA approved.

Samir Kapoor: Quick paste of last.log tail: ```[2026-02-12T14:18:22Z] AUTH: looking for user cert
[2026-02-12T14:18:22Z] AUTH: certificate not found for CN=samir.kapoor
[2026-02-12T14:18:22Z] AUTH: aborting auth flow
[2026-02-12T14:18:22Z] ERROR: Authentication failed - user cert missing
```

Renee (IT): Thanks, that confirms the cert installer didn't create the user cert. I'm going to escalate to identity team. I'll also mark a P2 ticket to replace the dock (since your audio adapter fails via dock) and queue a loaner headset in case shipping delays. Opening ticket now.

Renee (IT): it-bot: Ticket IT-2392 created for Samir Kapoor 1: "Dock passthrough fails for USB audio adapter, monitor RMA RM-5589, user cert missing for VPN". ETA triage 3 hours.

Marina (People Ops): Welcome Samir :tada: I'm so sorry about the damaged monitor 622. Logistics is on it per the bot. If you need temporary gear or a coworking stipend while things ship, DM me and I can sort it quickly. Also ping your manager to confirm workspace setup if you'll be onsite.

Nate (Facilities): @Samir if you're planning to use the SF office I can drop a loaner monitor and headset at Reception today. Otherwise we'll ship replacements as Logistics noted.

Samir Kapoor: Appreciate everyone. I'm remote in Oakland so loaner won't help, but the stipend would be handy until replacements arrive. I'll check Keychain and post screenshots if the identity team asks. Thanks Renee, ping me for a remote session if needed — I'm available this afternoon.

Renee (IT): Copy that. I'll coordinate identity and logistics, set IT-2392 to track the dock replacement and RM-5589 for the monitor. We'll also push a remote firmware probe to the dock to capture USB descriptors before replacement. Leaving this thread open until you confirm replacements arrived or issue resolved. :thumbsup:"
